description: Test suite for import-related commands in Mattermost's mmctl CLI, including listing imports, incomplete uploads, job details, processing, validation, and deletion.

classes.name: MmctlUnitTestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for import command tests.

methods.name: TestImportListAvailableCmdF
methods.description: Tests listing available import files with no files and with some files.

methods.name: TestImportListIncompleteCmdF
methods.description: Tests listing incomplete uploads with no uploads and with some uploads.

methods.name: TestImportJobShowCmdF
methods.description: Tests showing a job by ID, handling not found and found cases.

methods.name: TestImportJobListCmdF
methods.description: Tests listing import jobs with no jobs and with some jobs.

methods.name: TestImportProcessCmdF
methods.description: Tests creating import process jobs with default, excessive, and custom worker counts.

methods.name: TestImportValidateCmdF
methods.description: Tests validating import files, including empty files, size limits, and invalid attachments.

methods.name: TestDeleteImportCmdF
methods.description: Tests deleting import files, including idempotency.
